'''''Wheels, Life and Other Mathematical Amusements''''' is a book by [[Martin Gardner]] published in 1983. The Basic Library List Committee of the [[Mathematical Association of America]] has recommended its inclusion in undergraduate mathematics libraries.<ref>{{cite web |title=Wheels, Life, and Other Mathematical Amusements |url=https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/wheels-life-and-other-mathematical-amusements |url-status=dead |access-date=2020-07-09 |publisher=Mathematical Association of America |archive-date=2020-07-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200712195652/https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/wheels-life-and-other-mathematical-amusements }}</ref>

==Contents==
''Wheels, Life and Other Mathematical Amusements'' is a book of 22 mathematical games columns that were revised and extended after being previously published in ''[[Scientific American]]''.<ref name="WD55"/> It is Gardner's 10th collection of columns, and includes material on [[Conway's Game of Life]], [[supertask]]s, [[intransitive dice]], braided [[polyhedra]], [[combinatorial game theory]], the [[Collatz conjecture]], mathematical card tricks, and [[Diophantine equation]]s such as [[Fermat's Last Theorem]].<ref>{{cite journal|title=Review of ''Wheels, Life and Other Mathematical Amusements''|journal=zbMATH|first=G. A.|last=Heuer|zbl=0537.00002}}</ref>

==Reception==
[[David Langford|Dave Langford]] reviewed ''Wheels, Life and Other Mathematical Amusements'' for ''[[White Dwarf (magazine)|White Dwarf]]'' #55, and stated that "Here too are revisions of the three famous pieces on Conway's solitaire game ''Life'', which has absorbed several National Debts' worth of computer time since 1970. Fascinating."<ref name="WD55">{{cite journal  | last =Langford | first =Dave | author-link =David Langford | title =Critical Mass  | journal =[[White Dwarf (magazine)|White Dwarf]]  | issue = 55  | pages =20  | publisher =[[Games Workshop]]  | date = July 1984  }}</ref> The book was positively reviewed in several other mathematics and science journals.<ref>Additional reviews:

*{{cite journal|last=Carter|first=D. C.|date=March 1985|doi=10.2307/3616487|issue=447|journal=[[The Mathematical Gazette]]|jstor=3616487|page=75|title=none|volume=69}}
